controls.inline: ()=>UI.busy(q('#remind'),'记录提醒中…',async()=>{const latest=Pet.read();if(latest?.status!=='pending'){missing();return false;}if(latest.lastReminder&&Date.now()-latest.lastReminder<60000)throw new Error('刚刚记录过提醒，请稍后再试');latest.lastReminder=Date.now();if(!Pet.commit(latest,'pet-remind'))return false;UI.toast('已记录本地提醒；不会发送真实消息','success');return true;})

controls.inline: function note(){const form=document.createElement('form'),field=UI.components.field({label:'今天的小心情',multiline:true,maxLength:500}),input=field.input,save=UI.components.button('保存小心情');save.type='submit';form.append(field.root,save);form.className='pet-note-form';form.noValidate=true;const protect=UI.protectSheet(form);form.onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();if(!UI.fieldError(input,input.value.trim()?'':'请填写今天的小心情'))return;UI.busy(save,'保存中…',async()=>{if(!Pet.note(input.value))return false;protect.commit();await UI.back();UI.toast('小心情已记录','success');paintTasks();return true;});};UI.sheet({title:'宠物小心情',message:'保存在宠物成长记录中，仅在当前浏览器演示。',content:form,actions:[],beforeClose:protect.beforeClose});}
